title: The AI Energy-Demand Forecast Scorecard (interactive)
description: An interactive page over version 0.5 of the AI Energy-Demand Forecast Scorecard. It shows each registered observation and candidate with its receipt status and source, and the like-for-like groups with their recorded spans, all generated from the version 0.5 records. The paper makes no demand forecast, accuracy ranking or capacity-uplift estimate. The page of the v0.2 dataset is kept in v0.2/. Companion to the paper at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20572928. CC BY 4.0.
